labels.note: Leading-whitespace 'javascript:' no longer flagged special; prefixed junk like 'x/javascript:' is. Affects XSS-related protocol detection.
Unanchored match finds a later '//' in inputs like 'mailto:x?u=http://y', giving the wrong host and protocol.
(.*) always matches, at worst an empty string. The old undefined also defaulted to '', so nothing changes.
Protocol-relative flag becomes '' (falsy), so stringifyParsedURL drops the leading '//' for '//host' URLs.
Consistent inside the module. Only observable to outside code that looks up the registry key Symbol.for('ufo:protocolRelative').
